name: er-income-tax
description: Personal income tax for employees, landlords and sole traders under Income Tax Proclamation 62/1994 as amended, plus the 2% tax on Eritreans abroad, with the bands, exemptions, deadlines and penalties. Covers tax year 2026 in Eritrea from the gazette text. Use for questions such as: how much income tax on a salary in Eritrea, Eritrea rent tax, sole trader tax in Asmara, the 2% diaspora tax.
